name: kallie
description: Kallie — Scheduled AI Voice Calling App (Expo + NestJS + LiveKit + Supabase)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix services/api install && npm --prefix services/agent install && npm --prefix apps/web install && npm --prefix apps/mobile install --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.test:all: npm run test:infra && npm run test:api && npm run test:agent
scripts.typecheck:all: npm run build:api && npm run build:agent && npm run typecheck:mobile
